title: Launch ops quickfire prep - Dedicated Autoscaler v1.3
content:
Context:
- Quick personal prep for tomorrow's release-train weekly (15m sync). Focusing on Dedicated Autoscaler v1.3 rollout for EU/US regions. Keep this terse — share the checklist in the huddle.

Meeting goals (what I want to surface):
1) Hard go/no-go criteria sanity check (SLOs, infra, docs, security).
2) Confirm owner alignment for final cutover tasks.
3) Surface any last-minute regressions or capacity shortfalls.
4) Lock CD/rollback play and on-call escalation.

Attendees (expected):
- Evelyn (owner, release lead)
- Marco (infra lead)
- Priya (SRE / observability)
- Jon (deploys / release-engineering)
- Lena (customer success ramp)
- Samir (security/compliance consultant)

Quick go/no-go checklist (short binary checks) — call each item: OK / BLOCKER / TBD
- Infra capacity validated for peak QPS with 25% buffer (benchmark run done) — Marco => OK
- Canary perf matches baseline latency target (p50/p95 within SLO) — Priya => TBD (retry benchmarks tonight)
- DB migrations applied and verified in staging -> Jon => OK
- Docs + admin runbook updated (playbook + rollback steps) -> Evelyn + Jon => OK
- Security sign-off on network policy/hardening -> Samir => OK
- Support runbook & CS notify list prepared -> Lena => OK
- Billing/quotas config validated for dedicated tenants -> Finance/ops (see OPS-9011) => TBD

Open risks (notes to self / speak up in the meeting):
- Observability gap: trace sampling not enabled in canary sidecars — causes blindspot at p95. Priya says patch tonight but might be late. If not fixed, mark as mitigated and require extended post-cutover watch.
- One heavy tenant (acct ACME-1) flagged higher token usage in last run. Consider temporary throttle policy if post-cutover latency rises.
- CI flakiness on the auto-scaler e2e test (intermittent env race); Jon to attach logs PR #312. Do not let e2e flakiness block go if infra and canary perf are good and smoke tests pass.

Escalation path / who to page (very short):
- Pager duty: primary SRE (Priya) -> backup infra (Marco) -> release lead (Evelyn) -> security (Samir)
- Post-cutover: 30m quiet window, then 2-hour watch with 15m rollups to exec channel if any p95 violations.

Action items (owner -> action -> due) — call these out during sync and tick off live:
- Priya -> finish canary benchmark + enable trace sampling on canary sidecars -> due: 2026-03-10 22:00 UTC
- Marco -> confirm extra node pool quotas are reserved in eu-west1/us-central1 -> due: 2026-03-11 09:00 UTC
- Jon -> attach e2e failure logs and short triage note on PR #312 -> due: 2026-03-10 16:00 UTC
- Evelyn -> post final go/no-go checklist to #release-ops Slack and tag CS/support -> due: 2026-03-11 10:00 UTC
- Lena -> prepare customer-facing heads-up draft (1-paragraph) + escalation contact table -> due: 2026-03-11 11:00 UTC
- Samir -> confirm there are no outstanding compliance flags for the new autoscaler metrics export -> due: 2026-03-11 12:00 UTC
- Finance -> validate dedicated tenant quota/billing hooks for the launch cohort (OPS-9011) -> due: 2026-03-11 14:00 UTC

Pre-cutover quick decision rules (stick to these):
- If canary p95 > SLO by >15% -> BLOCK and escalate to infra; do not proceed until mitigated.
- If billing/quotas are misconfigured for any launch tenant -> proceed only for non-billed customers; otherwise delay.
- If security flags remain open -> BLOCK.

Notes / talking points to drop in the huddle (bullet phrases)
- "Perf looks good except p95 trace hole — Priya patch ETA 22:00 UTC."
- "We have reserved extra nodes in both regions, Marco verified quotas."
- "E2E flake under investigation, mitigation: rely on smoke + canary perf for go decision."
- "Support onboarding: Lena will push the one-pager to #customer-updates once final go."

Post-meeting follow-ups (my plan):
- If go: create a single threaded channel #launch-dedicated-autoscaler and invite all owners + CS reps. Post timestamps for phased cutover (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- If blocker: assemble quick triage call with owners and mark decision + next checkpoint (max 6 hours).

Random notes / scratch bits (keep here for quick copy/paste into meeting):
- "Canary run: 2k concurrent sessions, 180k tokens/minute. Observed p50 42ms, p95 280ms (target 250ms)."
- "Unclear if throttles on ACME-1 are customer-config or ap-sector; file ticket to product for follow-up."

Questions I want to ask the team in the sync:
- Is anyone planning infra changes tonight that could conflict with the cutover window?
- Can Priya commit to 22:00 UTC patch? If not, what is the mitigation?

Final quick checklist I will paste in the huddle message (one-liners):
- Canary perf OK? (Priya)
- Infra quotas reserved? (Marco)
- Docs + runbooks ready? (Evelyn/Jon)
- Security clear? (Samir)
- CS notified? (Lena)
- Billing/quotas validated? (Finance)

-- end scratchpad --
(If this doc is helpful, copy final checklist into the release playbook page after the meeting.)
